verdict.rationale: The pack's migration docs describe importing data into Stripe only: the Billing migration toolkit, imports from Zuora, Recurly, Chargify and Chargebee, and general data migration to Stripe. Nothing documents exporting subscriptions, invoices or usage records, or porting stored payment methods to another provider. One community comment mentions a team writing its own code to move off Stripe, but it does not describe any supported export or payment-method portability path.
